work.name: NTNU, Department of Sociology and Political Science
work.summary: My doctoral project focuses on how large language models and AI are implemented in central government.
highlights: **Research groups:** Public Policy and Administration; Technology and Social Change; EVPOC (Elections, Values, and Political Communication); and Organization and Society.
**Teaching:** Lecturer for POL2017, Specialization in Political Science: Public Policy and Administration (2026), and SAM1020, Citizenship Education, in the teacher education programme (2025).

**Boards and councils:** Department Board (2025-2026); Faculty Board, Programme Council for PhD Candidates at Faculty of Social and Educational Sciences, Research Committee (2026-2027); Hiring Committee, Faculty of Social and Educational Sciences (2026-2027); NTNU Board (2026-2027).

**Service:** Reviewer for Public Management Review and International Journal of Public Administration; member of the local organizing committee for the International Research Society in Public Management (IRSPM) 2027 conference in Trondheim (2026-2027).
**Research schools:** NORA HS, the Norwegian AI Research School for Humanities and Society (2026-2028); Digit, The Norwegian Research School on Digitalization, Culture, and Society (2026-2028).

work.name: ISS, NTNU (Department of Sociology and Political Science, Faculty of Social and Educational Sciences)
work.summary: Part of the teaching staff in statistics at the master's and PhD levels at the Faculty of Social and Educational Sciences (course SOS3003).
highlights: Led 18 seminars in applied statistics (linear and logistic regression) using STATA.
Increased student attendance and received strong anonymous evaluations.
Coordinated teaching with two professors and other course staff, revising the course for the following year.
